rubric_name: AI Security Engineer Phone-Screen — Builder-First Hybrid
purpose: Score a phone-screen transcript for an AI Security Engineer role where the primary expectation is building ML/LLM systems that detect and prevent risk at scale, with security as the problem domain.

mandatory_skills_definition: Mandatory skills indicate the candidate can build and own detection or prevention systems.
Failing mandatory builder or detection skills → auto-reject or hard cap.
Desired skills add confidence but are not required.
Optional skills improve score but cannot penalize.

inputs_required.jd_highlights: Extracted mandatory vs desired competencies from JD.

scoring_mindset: Score ONLY what the candidate says.
Prioritize systems built, ownership, metrics, failures, and iteration.
Reward direction + one real system, signal, or outcome.
Use NA if the TA never surfaced a question.
India phone-screen leniency applies: brief answers are acceptable if evidence exists.

dimensions.title: System Building & Ownership
dimensions.jd_mapping: Primary requirement: ability to build and own ML/AI systems used in production.

band_guide.4: Built system with metrics and iteration.

dimensions.title: Detection & Prevention Design
dimensions.jd_mapping: Design of signals, decision logic, and outcomes to detect or prevent risk.

dimensions.title: AI / LLM Security Basics
dimensions.jd_mapping: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, and data leakage awareness applied to systems built.

dimensions.title: ML / LLM Pipeline Fundamentals
dimensions.jd_mapping: Data ingestion, training, inference, evaluation, and improvement.

dimensions.title: Python Automation & Tooling
dimensions.jd_mapping: Python used for automation, pipelines, or blocking checks.

dimensions.title: Secure Data Access (RAG / Non-RAG)
dimensions.jd_mapping: Safe retrieval and access control for data used by ML/LLM systems.

dimensions.title: Cloud Deployment & Runtime
dimensions.jd_mapping: Deploying, operating, and scaling systems in production.

dimensions.title: Incident Handling & Ownership
dimensions.jd_mapping: Ownership of failures, fixes, and prevention.

normalization.total_50_definition: Weighted sum of all NON-gate mandatory + desired skills.

gates: Cap detection and security dimensions at 2 if candidate only describes API usage with no ownership

bonuses.when: Mentions a real metric, outcome, or impact after deployment.
Clear iteration or improvement after failure or scale issue.

tally_and_verdict.total_50_definition: Sum of all non-gate mandatory + desired dimensions after NA adjustments (max 50).
verdict_rules: SELECT if total_50 ≥ 34 AND no auto-reject rule is triggered.
GREY if total_50 is between 26 and 33 (inclusive) AND no auto-reject rule.
REJECT if total_50 ≤ 25 OR any auto-reject rule triggers.
